column1: # Adaptive inference pacing. Rows sharing a case run in file order on one fresh policy; exact values, no tolerance.
# Corners are normalized upright TL,TR,BR,BL as eight comma-separated numbers; - means none or not applicable.
# width/height are upright frame pixels. gap is nanoseconds before the next inference; max pauses it.
# Steps: reference (corners), confirmed, reset, next (tracking, reliable, degraded, corners, width, height -> gap, status, lastReset, doubt).
